items.title: Albert Francis Interview, 1961-08-04
items.q: I remember I took his job... Sidney Bechet. I know Sidney Bechet. Well, yeah. That was one of them nightclubs, you know, then. He'd sleep all day. John Veen, he's there. He used to play bass on the parade.

ctx.x: Well, he used to talk about the John Veen. Do you remember?
John Veen, oh, he's an old man.
